verdict.rationale: Spline offers indirect forms of acting on many items at once: editing a main component updates all of its instances, and Boolean operations apply to a set of selected objects. The AI Agent and MCP server can also drive the editor programmatically, but nothing in the evidence describes batch or bulk operations as such. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit or multi-select property changes, documented batch operations through the MCP or AI agent, bulk actions across files or scenes, and hands-on corroboration.
